name: Tank Rally
description: A little 3D arcade tank game: drive round five arenas, shoot the crates, grab the coins before the clock runs out, chain combos and beat your best score. A new layout every run.

descriptions.en: A little 3D arcade tank game: drive round five arenas, shoot the crates, grab the coins before the clock runs out, chain combos and beat your best score. A new layout every run.
descriptions.it: Un piccolo gioco arcade in 3D con un carro armato: cinque arene, spara alle casse, raccogli le monete prima che scada il tempo, concatena le combo e batti il record. Ogni partita il campo cambia.
